subject.title: Dashboard: full-bleed tab layout + "tab app" bundle

question: Should OpenClaw add a bundled dashboard full-bleed tab-app mode, or should tab apps stay as external plugin/ClawHub packages using the existing plugin-tab iframe seam?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing dashboard composition mode around untrusted widget presentation, and current source only proves the generic plugin-tab seam exists, not that this should become bundled dashboard product surface.

options.title: Review after Wave 1 lands
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide the full-bleed layout once the dashboard workspace and custom-widget stack have a stable schema and security boundary.

options.title: Route to plugin packaging
options.body: Document a ClawHub/plugin bundle convention if the existing plugin-tab iframe seam is sufficient without adding bundled dashboard layout state.

options.title: Defer the app layer
options.body: Leave the broader dashboard roadmap open but pause this item until maintainers want web-app tabs as a product direction.

recommendation.title: Review after Wave 1 lands
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide the full-bleed layout once the dashboard workspace and custom-widget stack have a stable schema and security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history owner for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and the likely product/security boundary decision.
